scope: Native Win32 Buoy desktop controls; WinUI-specific implementation APIs are not assumed
sourceCaveat: The Win32 UX Guide explicitly describes Windows 7-era guidance. Treat its pixel tables as font/DPI-qualified recommendations, not current universal widget metrics.

rules.title: Fixed UI colors need a contrast-theme review
rules.recommendation: Prefer semantic system/theme colors, preserve foreground/background pairs, and test contrast themes when fixed colors are necessary.

rules.title: Noninteractive labels should not add tab stops
rules.recommendation: Keep keyboard traversal on interactive controls and meaningful groups; static labels normally stay out of the Tab sequence.

rules.title: Review Command modifiers in Windows menus
rules.recommendation: Use Windows command conventions; a menu shortcut observed with Cmd or Command warrants platform-mapping review.
exceptions: A toolkit explicitly translates the modifier; dispatch must still be tested

rules.title: Verify the native accessible name and label association
rules.recommendation: Inspect the accessibility provider's actual name. Native MSAA may obtain a control name from the preceding static label in tab order.
rules.falsePositiveRisk: Visual proximity, source ordering, and the Buoy property getter alone do not prove the native provider's label relationship.

rules.title: Name graphical command buttons
rules.recommendation: A graphical button needs an action-oriented text name exposed to assistive technology; an ellipsis browse button should announce its action.
exceptions: A meaningful natural caption already supplies the name

rules.title: Verify Tab, Shift+Tab and grouped navigation
rules.recommendation: Test a logical traversal sequence, reverse traversal, group arrow navigation and escape from groups. Confirm visible focus.
exceptions: Radio groups use one tab stop and internal arrow navigation

rules.title: Verify Enter, Space and Escape effects
rules.recommendation: Exercise Enter on the current default action, Space on the focused control and Escape on cancel/close. Focus can change the effective default button.
exceptions: Transient popup dismissal before window cancellation

rules.title: Check standard command shortcuts by their effects
rules.recommendation: Confirm customary editing shortcuts act on the focused applicable control, rather than merely displaying a shortcut in a menu.
exceptions: Read-only or inapplicable commands should be unavailable
Application-specific commands must not repurpose established shortcuts

rules.title: Apply dialog-unit guidance only with matching metrics
rules.recommendation: Classic tables assume 9pt Segoe UI at 96 DPI: dialog margins 7 DLU, related-control spacing 4 DLU, single-line edit height 14 DLU. Convert with actual dialog font metrics.
rules.falsePositiveRisk: DLUs, relative pixels, physical pixels and Buoy layout units are not interchangeable.

rules.title: Avoid clipping meaningful content
rules.recommendation: Size controls for expected content and localization. Review initial surfaces that need immediate resizing, truncated essential text or unnecessary scrolling.
exceptions: Intentional ellipsis with an accessible full value

rules.title: Test DPI transitions, not just initial scaling
rules.sourceTitle: High DPI Desktop Application Development on Windows
rules.recommendation: Test startup and transitions between differently scaled monitors, docking and display-scale changes. Win32 framework support must be verified rather than assumed.
rules.falsePositiveRisk: A single successful 96-DPI PNG does not establish DPI awareness or transition behaviour.

rules.title: Exercise text scaling and default-theme contrast
rules.recommendation: Verify readable text at user text-size settings and sufficient default foreground/background contrast. Do not rely on contrast themes as the only readability mitigation.
rules.implementationCaveat: WinUI automatic text-scaling APIs do not imply equivalent behaviour for Buoy's Win32 controls.

rules.title: Keep custom controls responsive to theme changes
rules.recommendation: Custom or owner-drawn UI must preserve user-selected contrast colors and refresh cached colors when the theme changes.
exceptions: Standard controls whose verified framework handles updates
